title: When KV Cache Reuse Fails in Multi-Agent Systems: Cross-Candidate Interaction is Crucial for LLM Judges
authors: Sichu Liang; Zhenglin Wang; Jiajia Chu; Pengfei Xia; Hui Zang; Deyu Zhou
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Cross-agent KV cache reuse can reduce repeated judge prefill, but judge agents must jointly compare candidate blocks whose KV tensors were formed under different execution contexts. Existing reuse schemes may leave end-task accuracy stable while changing which candidate the judge selects, undermining attribution and auditability.
problem_statement.zh: 跨 agent 的 KV cache 重用可減少 judge prefill 的重複運算，但 judge agent 必須聯合比較多個 candidate block，而其 KV tensors 是在不同 execution context 下形成。既有重用方案可能在最終任務 accuracy 維持穩定時改變 judge 所選候選，進而削弱 attribution 與 auditability。

key_innovation.en: A judge-centric diagnostic framework that introduces Judge Consistency Rate (JCR) to measure selection invariance against dense prefill. Attention-region analysis and a cross-candidate masking ablation trace failures to weakened cross-candidate interaction, while PAL-KV pools anchors across agents to test and largely rule out agent identity as the dominant cause.
key_innovation.zh: 提出以 judge 為中心的診斷框架，並以 Judge Consistency Rate (JCR) 衡量相對於 dense prefill 的選擇不變性。attention region 分析與 cross-candidate masking ablation 將失效歸因於跨候選互動減弱；PAL-KV 則跨 agent 彙集 anchor，以檢驗並大致排除 agent identity 為主要成因。

key_improvements.en: Across MMLU, GSM8K, and HumanEval with shuffled candidates, Naïve Reuse attains 100% candidate-block reuse but only 19.88–27.95% JCR, while KVCOMM/PAL-KV attain 21.74–51.75% JCR. Masking cross-candidate attention under dense prefill reduces JCR from 100% to 22.22–32.03%, identifying interaction loss as the key failure mechanism.
key_improvements.zh: 在 MMLU、GSM8K 與 HumanEval 的候選 shuffle 設定中，Naïve Reuse 雖達到 100% candidate-block 重用率，JCR 僅為 19.88–27.95%；KVCOMM/PAL-KV 的 JCR 為 21.74–51.75%。在 dense prefill 下遮蔽 cross-candidate attention，會使 JCR 由 100% 降至 22.22–32.03%，顯示互動損失是主要失效機制。

reuse_metric.en: JCR is the share of examples for which reuse selects the same candidate as dense prefill. With shuffled candidates, Naïve Reuse reuses 100% of candidate blocks but reaches only 19.88–27.95% JCR; KVCOMM/PAL-KV reuse 31.86–66.96% and reach 21.74–51.75% JCR.
reuse_metric.zh: JCR 表示重用方法與 dense prefill 選擇相同候選的樣本比例。在候選 shuffle 設定中，Naïve Reuse 重用 100% 的 candidate block，但 JCR 僅為 19.88–27.95%；KVCOMM/PAL-KV 的重用率為 31.86–66.96%，JCR 為 21.74–51.75%。
